description: Add a listing photo, logo or headshot to the account from an https link (JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 25 MB) or base64 (up to about 3 MB of file). Returns a storageId for add_photos, replace_photo, set_logo or set_headshot.

filename.description: The file's name, like 'kitchen.jpg'; used to label it.

kind.description: What the file is for: photo (a listing photo), logo or headshot.

url.description: An https link the server fetches.

name: upload_media
title: Upload a file
